title: Web-page visual-search performance with 1.5 and 2 line spacing
statement:
In web-page visual-search experiments, 1.5-line and 2-line spacing produced better performance than single spacing, so 1.5 is a sensible content-reading baseline and 2 can be used when search accuracy matters more than density.

Options:
- Dense: 1.0 (fits: high density, data rich)
- Reading baseline: 1.5 (fits: balanced, editorial)
- Search-friendly: 2.0 (fits: access-first, calm)
- Middle ground: 1.7 (fits: comfortable, friendly)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web, web apps, content sites. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: The influence of line spacing and text alignment on visual search of web pages
